about: Doors and windows of answered recognition jobs, with what they really are. tools/measure_openings.py replays each through cabinet-recognizer (services/cabinet-recognizer/tests/data/<case>.answers.json) and the kitchen's type choice, and compares. Ratios: dividers as fractions of the opening, from the left / from the sill.
